title: Morning Sounds on the Mountain Path

scenes.title: Mountain path and distant bells
scenes.narration: A five-character poem, written for this film. Thin mist opens the mountain path. Slow bells drift past the far shore. Pause at the bell as the misty path appears.
scenes.sourceQuote: A five-character poem, written for this film. Thin mist opens the mountain path. Slow bells drift past the far shore. Pause at the bell as the misty path appears.

props.title: Morning Sounds on the Mountain Path
translations: Thin mist opens the mountain path,
slow bells drift past the far shore.

scenes.title: Stream light and homing birds
scenes.narration: Stream light sways the bamboo shade. Homing birds vanish into blue cloud. Our gaze lifts from the water to the sky. The birds fly off, but the blue stays behind.
scenes.sourceQuote: Stream light sways the bamboo shade. Homing birds vanish into blue cloud. Our gaze lifts from the water to the sky. The birds fly off, but the blue stays behind.

props.title: Morning Sounds on the Mountain Path
translations: Stream light sways the bamboo shade,

scenes.title: Follow the senses
scenes.narration: The poem has no people, only morning senses. We see the path, then hear the far bell. We look down at the stream, then up at birds.
scenes.sourceQuote: The poem has no people, only morning senses. We see the path, then hear the far bell. We look down at the stream, then up at birds.

props.heading: From mountain path to far sky

scenes.title: Leave a breath of space
scenes.narration: Hold a silence, then look back up the path. It gives no answer, only sends the dawn afar.
scenes.sourceQuote: Hold a silence, then look back up the path. It gives no answer, only sends the dawn afar.

props.title: Send the Morning Far
props.subtitle: Leave space, and let the poem linger
